title: Punctured star bit unit: bit c = 0.00165947204563779652541 (+4.54% over #510)
body:
This adds one self-contained package, `research/e8-punctured111-star/`: an E8 bit word with **111 live ports** (9 of #493's 120 labelled lines punctured) whose nine decoder totals are rank-7 pseudo-target helpers (decoder constant 63, not 72), **R = 489** helpers, and the parameterisation of #493's hosted-audit chain that prices it.

| quantity | value |
|---|---|
| bit c, eleven stages, eight pooled replicas, every residual whole and hosted (10^-24 grid; #472's pipeline as #493 runs it) | `165947204563779652541/10^23` = **0.00165947204563779652541** |
| live bit c: #510's R480 word at nine stages (the bit supplier of #535) | 0.001587447106092548137108 -> **+4.54%** |
| #503's R480 word, same pipeline (reproduced) | 0.001574753352953808650916 -> +5.38% |
| independent pricing harness, same word | equal to all 24 digits and the same profile |
| c under a stricter hosting (one helper per family copy per stage) | >= 0.001651282591289915996071 (at most 0.49% lower) |
| **κ with #535's complex b** (`1589991533606044174031/10^24`) | **0.001587467473762886 = 793733736881443/5*10^17, complex-bound, +0.16% over #535** (0.001584931111785787) |

**For context.** #543 (eumemic, 420 helpers, unpunctured, nine-stage) reaches c = 1.653827e-3; this word's c is 0.34% higher.

**On κ.** #535's complex b is 4.37% below this unit's c, so κ is complex-bound and moves by only +0.16% over #535. The same outer code reproduces #535's published κ (0.001584931111785787) from #510's bit c and the same b (step 9, control). The bit word raises the cap: any future complex b up to about 1.659e-3 would now be bit-slack. Nothing here claims more than that.

### What it is
* PR #493's quad skeleton restricted to 111 live lines (P = [39, 52, 57, 71, 76, 78, 103, 109, 114], one punctured line in each of nine 4-frames; lines 0..7 stay live). Each punctured line leaves a rank-7 total, a helper that reads exactly what the removed target would read; the nine totals cannot sit on dead registers (rank 7). `verify.py` rebuilds the word byte for byte from #493's frozen plan.
* Rank-mass identity `M*live - mass = T(10v - 11 cst)` (telescoping, any v): 3336 for v = 111, cst = 63 (3264 at v = 120, cst = 72).
* Payload 91 bits < 104; 636 frames, all Gram > 0 (prime 2 only); exact F2 on all 711 columns.

### The parameterisation
`code/adapt.py` writes adapted copies of nine of #493's files by 55 exact string edits (each anchor counted); the parent tree is untouched, nothing is read from the environment. One configuration (`code/punct_cfg.py`): v, R and the live labels come from the word, the copy-rank sum (63) is replayed from the word, derived again from the records by `audit.py` and the two must agree. The cited complex b enters `assemble.py` as a bare rational; the bit v is not tied to any complex port count (mutant M6 sets v := 112 and is refused).

### Checks (`verify.py`, `--light` skips #493's own `verify.sh`)
Independent checker for v <= 120 plus an E8-membership check, `interface.py`, the word-level mutants, the official legality / five- and eleven-stage column checkers (24/24 omitted-bridge controls), exact Gram, #442 hosting rediscovery, #472 emit and independent audit (22 template mutations), the 47-inequality outer assembly with controls, and the pricing harness.
* **Regression:** #503's R480 word through the stock chain and the adapted chain: GLOBAL.json, GLOBAL-TEMPLATE.json.gz, AUDIT.json, RESULT.json byte-identical; c, profile, emitted-program sha256 and the three κ equal #503's EXPECTED.
* **8 mutation controls, all rejected:** a dropped gate and a wrong frame (relaxed checker), a payload overflow (legal and F2-correct; refused only by `columns_h`), a hosted-cell collision, a helper hosted on the family the call acts on, a cheaper profile claim, v tied to 112, the stock #493 emitter.

### Scope and caveats
* **Hosting stacks helpers on one family.** The hosting is the pooled whole-residual programme of #442 / #472 / #493 (`hosting_core.solve`): in 82 of 88 calls several helpers of one invocation share a family (at most 7) at disjoint cells, so #458's literal one-owner-per-family rule is not met. This is inherited: #503's accepted emitted program does the same in 80 of 88 calls (reproduced). Mutant M4a tests cell collisions, not #458. Under the stricter "one helper per family copy per stage" rule c >= 0.001651283 (at most 0.49% lower) and κ is unchanged.
* The word is checked as a `bitE8/1` word with 111 labels in the 120-line E8 system; everything #493 and #472 assume (all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-basis interface, whole-call hosting) is assumed unchanged. No unconditional claim.
* Eleven stages only: the nine-stage hosting wall is R <= 4v = 444. Of 414 sampled punctures, 304 reach R = 489 and 110 need 1-3 Q-node junk wires; the shipped word has the highest c found. No claim that 489 is a floor for other skeletons.

### Credit
#493 (eumemic) for the skeleton, the word family and the chain; #523 (icekylinx) for the puncture pattern on the complex side; #503 (DreamingOfClouds) for the dead-total variant and the `adapt.py` pattern; #472 (chafreaky), #442 (DaysSky), #445, #386, #370 (Dylan Crow), #381, #315 for the pipeline and checkers; #510 for the live bit c; #535 (icekylinx) for the cited complex b. An independent audit supplied the stricter-hosting repricing.
